products.name: Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Binder Collection
products.region: English-language markets; allocation varies by market
products.summary: The official product page confirms a 9-pocket binder and five 30th Celebration booster packs. The same page currently displays a September 2026 launch, so the widely reported December 4 date is not treated as confirmed here.
products.contents: 9-pocket binder and five Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs

products.name: Moncolle 30th Anniversary Paldea Legendary Set
products.summary: Takara Tomy's official product page lists the Paldea Legendary Set for an early-December release. An exact calendar day and an official online purchase listing were not available at verification time.

products.name: Pokémon Visual Art Book: 30th Anniversary
products.summary: Publisher Overlap confirms three B5, full-color volumes released simultaneously. The listed price is per volume, not for a three-book set.
products.contents: BOOK1, BOOK2 and BOOK3; approximately 1,500 pages total planned

products.name: Pokémon Kids 30th Anniversary Collection
products.summary: Bandai Candy lists the anniversary collection for December 2026. The exact release day, final retail availability and purchase links remain unannounced.
products.contents: Anniversary soft-vinyl figure assortment with one card and one piece of gum per item
